title: A Collective has a network home: one shared calendar and a directory of its member Spaces
detail: PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on the collaborator calendar. Required before Founding Collective sells. Public network home now composes eligible same-owner active network member Spaces and the existing published-event tenancy/hosting/accepted-share reader. Every month re-resolves caller-visible parent and child eligibility; owner management remains a separate billing door. Cancellations stay calendar context and never lead Up next. Targeted visibility/cross-tenant and month access checks pass; integrated CI remains to run after LIVE-763 lands.
